mentions.name: Cascade Puzzle
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game inspired by Panel de Pon / Tetris Attack in which players swap blocks horizontally to match 3+ and trigger chain reactions, clearing the board in limited moves. It offers three daily puzzles (Easy/Medium/Hard) with Wordle-style shareable results and requires no account. Its puzzle generator uses backward construction (starting from a solved board and reversing moves) so every puzzle is guaranteed solvable.
mentions.problem: Puzzle generation was hard to get right, which caused the project to be abandoned years ago; it was solved with backward construction that guarantees every generated puzzle is solvable.
